passages.text: The periods of infancy, boyhood, youth, and old age, are different; but I, who have been infant, boy, and youth, am still the same.
passages.note: Ageing and staying oneself through life's stages

passages.text: We are more industrious, and we are better men if we anticipate the day and welcome the dawn; but we are base churls if we lie dozing when the sun is high in the heavens, or if we wake up only when noon arrives; and even then to many it seems not yet dawn.
passages.note: Lethargy, sleeping late, starting the day well
